goal: Stop the repeated relational repair family, reconstruct the full failure lineage, and select a clean-sheet execution abstraction before another trainable model.
root_cause_hypothesis: Relational query execution was repeatedly expressed as residual or mixture corrections around a global parent field-decision surface; edge binding, role execution, and applicability were not factored into independent first-class computations.
method_lessons: Treat repeated architecture failures around one boundary as one failure family rather than independent local bugs.
Use counterfactual execution to distinguish gating, binding, and executor competence.
Prove the execution factorization with deterministic oracle contracts before implementing another learned architecture.
When semantic information is already recoverable, do not retrain the backbone to compensate for a downstream execution abstraction.
Separate applicability, support selection, relation/argument execution, and fallback so one failure cannot masquerade as another.
